sentences.sentence: If any of those differ between the two arms, the test can't separate them from the treatment effect.

sentences.label: silent
sentences.sentence: For example, if all controls were prepared on one day and all treated samples on another, the two would be completely confounded.

sentences.label: silent

sentences.label: silent
sentences.sentence: A balanced 3-vs-3 design can be tested, but small effects will be hard to detect.
